meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Coordinate supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, and decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` for full ownership handoffs — "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree" — unless asked to supervise, monitor, or coordinate a DAG, and for terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, and reading or waiting on terminals.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把复杂工作拆成多个环节,派给多个助手并行执行并汇总结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务太重,想拆给多个 AI 助手分头做完再统一汇总。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a task is too big to do alone and you want several assistants to split it and report back.

howto.what: 它自己不内置协调命令:先确定本会话该用哪个 Orca 可执行文件,再从该二进制加载与版本匹配的 Orca 指南,然后按指南做多 agent 协调,如线程化消息、任务分发、等待 worker 完成。
howto.when: 当你需要结构化的多 agent 协调时触发,例如线程化消息、阻塞式 ask/reply、任务分发等。若只是完整的归属交接(handoff)或普通终端控制,则改用 orca-cli 技能。

say.text: 用 Orca 把这批任务分发给几个 worker,并等它们做完
say.note: 先加载版本匹配指南,再执行协调

say.text: 用 Orca 跑一个协调循环,盯着 worker 的进度和升级
say.note: 它会按指南轮询 worker_done 与升级

say.text: 用 Orca 协调一个任务 DAG,在关键处设一个决策门
say.note: 按 DAG 顺序推进并在门槛处停下

howto.what_en: It ships no coordination commands itself: it resolves which Orca executable this session should use, loads the version-matched guide from that binary, then runs multi-agent coordination per the guide.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need structured multi-agent coordination, e.g. threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, or task dispatch. For full ownership handoffs, use the orca-cli skill instead.

say_en.text: Use Orca to dispatch these tasks to a few workers and wait for them
say_en.note: Loads the version-matched guide, then coordinates

say_en.text: Run an Orca coordinator loop and watch workers for escalations
say_en.note: Polls worker_done and escalations per the guide

say_en.text: Coordinate a task DAG in Orca with a decision gate
say_en.note: Advances the DAG and stops at the gate
